memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent in all activities of daily living; walks to college campus, teaches lectures without assistance.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5; no memory complaints.
falls: No falls in the last 12 months; gait normal; timed up-and-go 8 seconds.
medicines: 3 regular; atorvastatin 10 mg HS, rosuvastatin 10 mg OD, fenofibrate 145 mg OD.
mood: Reports good mood, enjoys work and family time.
carers: Spouse, Priya Kulkarni.
goals: "I want to keep my cholesterol under control and stay active for my lectures."
